hotspots.name: North Ashlar Bedding Fracture
hotspots.description: Contiguous bedding joint fracture extending across 3 ashlar courses in northern pavilion gallery.

hotspots.name: Upper Parapet Root Intrusion
hotspots.description: Deep woody root network penetrating dry-jointed sandstone facing, displacing crest coping stones.

hotspots.name: South Lower Tier Surface Delamination
hotspots.description: Sub-surface cryptoflorescence causing stone flaking and 15mm surface detachment.

hotspots.name: West Catchment Stormwater Intake
hotspots.description: Stormwater feeder duct clogged with alluvial silt and agricultural runoff debris, halting monsoon recharge.

hotspots.name: Bottom Basin Sediment Layer
hotspots.description: Heavy silt deposition covering ancient stone pavement and suffocating bed aquifer seepage pores.
